findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_daily_briefing, search_pr_news, search_news, get_latest_analysis, get_airport_status, get_grid_reliability, get_pr_holidays, get_road_closures, trip_plan_link · Private data: get_ferry_status, get_beach_water_quality, get_events, get_grid_reliability · Public sink: get_daily_briefing, get_power_status, get_pr_holidays, flood_zone_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_daily_briefing, search_pr_news, search_news, get_latest_analysis, get_airport_status, get_grid_reliability, get_pr_holidays, get_road_closures, trip_plan_link · Private data: get_ferry_status, get_beach_water_quality, get_events, get_grid_reliability · Public sink: get_daily_briefing, get_power_status, get_pr_holidays, flood_zone_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
